help.crystal.text: The crystal represents the game's currency.
help.crystal.effect1:
At any time during your turn and as much as you like:

You can spend 4 <crystal /> to generate a basic resource of your choice: <leaf />, <flower />, <fruit />.
help.crystal.effect2:
You can turn over one of your active apprentices to take 1 <crystal />. You do not activate the tile it is on. 
<italic>Recovering 1 <crystal /> in this way does not count as an action.</italic>
help.apprentice.work: To put one of your apprentices to work, choose one of your active apprentices (symbol identical to that of your Druid), and turn it over to perform a Billhook, Chaudron or Temple action, or simply earn 1 <crystal />.
help.apprentice.state:
To tell whether an apprentice is active or inactive, refer to the visible face of your Druid. 
If the apprentice is on the same face as your Druid, he's active and can work (see below). 
If not, he's inactive.
help.field.bonus: Bonus spot: <bonus/> (earn this bonus when you build the tile, or when you place an apprentice on the bonus spot)
help.field.7: Pay <leaf/>, <flower/> or <fruit/> to earn 2 VP for each green field tile where you have at least one apprentice.
help.field.8: Pay <potion1/> to earn 3 VP for each green field tile where you have at least one apprentice.
help.field.12: Pay 3 <crystal/> to earn 2 VP for each yellow field tile where you have at least one apprentice.
help.field.15: Pay <potion2/> to earn 3 VP for each white field tile where you have at least one apprentice.
help.field.16: Pay <leaf/>, <flower/> or <fruit/> to earn 2 VP for each white field tile where you have at least one apprentice.
help.field.19: Pay <fruit/> and 2 <crystal/> to earn 3 VP for each purple field tile where you have at least one apprentice.
help.field.20: Pay <fruit/> to earn 2 VP for each <cauldron/> field tile where you have at least one apprentice.
help.field.22: Pay <leaf/> to earn 2 VP for each secondary Divinity card in your possession.
help.field.23: Pay 2 <crystal/> to earn 3 VP for each Salamander card in your possession.
help.field.24: Pay 3 <crystal/> to earn 2 VP for each Grove card you have harvested.
help.grove.description: Grove tiles are added to the game board when, by building a field tile, an empty space is created between 4 field tiles.
help.grove.crystal: When you place an apprentice on a space on a field tile, you collect as many <crystal/> as are present on the paths connected to the apprentice.
help.grove.take: When you pass, you can collect, for 3 <crystal/>, grove tiles that have at least 1 apprentice connected by a path. Immediately earn the gain indicated on the harvested grove tile. The 2nd grove tile earns you 4 VP, the 4th: 3 VP and the 6th: 2 VP.
help.grove.take.effect.points: Earn {points, plural, one{# Veneration Point} other{# Veneration Points}}
help.grove.take.effect.divinity: Draw the first {divinity, select, 1{eagle <eagle/>} other{bears <bear/>}} divinity card
help.spellbook.description: As soon as you earn your 4th scroll token, discard 4 of them, then choose one of your apprentices in play (active or inactive), on a tile, and place it on an available Spellbook card slot, where you are not already present.
help.spellbook.points.fields.white: per white field tile with at least 1 of your apprentices on it
help.spellbook.points.fields.orange: per orange field tile with at least 1 of your apprentices on it
help.spellbook.points.fields.green: per green field tile with at least 1 of your apprentices on it
help.spellbook.points.fields.purple: per purple field tile with at least 1 of your apprentices on it
help.spellbook.points.salamanders: per salamander cards in your possession
help.spellbook.points.divinities: per divinity cards in your possession
help.spellbook.points.groveTiles: per grove tile in your possession
help.spellbook.points.cauldrons: per cauldron-type field tile with at least 1 of your apprentices on it
help.spellbook.points.spellbooks: per spellbook card with 1 of your apprentices on it
help.majorities.rule:
At the end of the game, for each divinity, the player with the most times the associated symbol wins the most VPs (12, 8 or 6). The player in second place also wins VPs (6, 4 or 3).
In the event of a tie, the VPs to which the players are entitled are divided equally between the tied players.
help.divinity.description:
You can pick up a bonus deity card when you pick up a grove tile, or when you build a field tile next to a field tile with the same color.
The eﬀet of this card now applies for the rest of the game.
help.divinity.end: In the final count, the player with the most {type, select, 1{<eagle/>} 2{<bear/>} other{<salamander/>}} symbols wins {first} points, the second wins {second} points.
help.divinity.discount.resource: Thanks to your <play>divinity card</play>, this exchange costs only 3 crystals.
help.divinity.potion: Thanks to your <play>god card</play>, you can:
help.divinity.equality.first: In the event of a tie for first place, add up the points for first and second place. The people concerned earn the total points divided by the number of people tied (round down). Other people receive no points.
help.divinity.equality.second:
In the event of a tie for second place, the people involved earn the points for second place, divided by the number of people involved (round down).
Note: you must have 1 Faith symbol of the deity concerned to claim VPs.
help.divinity.effects.50: Gain 2 Veneration Points every time you take a divinity card.
help.divinity.effects.51: You can pay 5 crystals for 1 green potion.
help.divinity.effects.52: Gain 1 crystal each time you take a divinity card.
help.divinity.effects.53: You can pay 5 crystals for 1 white/purple potion.
help.divinity.effects.54: Gain 1 Veneration Point each time you harvest a grove tile.
help.divinity.effects.55: Gain 1 Veneration Point each time you take a divinity card.
help.divinity.effects.56: Gain 2 Veneration Points every time you take a salamander card.
help.divinity.effects.57: Gain 1 crystal every time you take a salamander card.
help.divinity.effects.58: You pay 3 crystals instead of 4 to buy a resource.
help.divinity.effects.59: Gain 2 points every time you place an apprentice on a grimoire.
help.divinity.effects.60: Gain 1 Veneration Point every time you take a salamander card.
help.divinity.effects.61: Earn 1 Veneration Point every time you place an apprentice on a cauldron-type field tile.
help.divinity.effects.1: Earn 1 Veneration Point every time you harvest a grove tile.
help.divinity.effects.2: Earn 1 crystal every time you place an apprentice on a cauldron-type grove tile.
help.divinity.effects.3: Earn 1 crystal every time you build a field tile.
help.divinity.effects.4: Gain 1 Veneration Point every time you gain a scroll token.
help.divinity.effects.5: Earn 2 crystals every time you place an apprentice on a spellbook.
help.divinity.effects.6: You can buy a white/purple potion for 6 crystals.
help.divinity.effects.7: Earn 2 Veneration Points every time you harvest a grove tile.
help.divinity.effects.8: You can pay 6 crystals for 1 green potion.
help.divinity.effects.9: Earn 1 Veneration Point every time you place an apprentice on a purple grove tile.
help.divinity.effects.10: Earn 1 Veneration Point every time you place an apprentice on a white grove tile.
help.divinity.effects.11: Earn 1 Veneration Point every time you place an apprentice on an orange grove tile.
help.divinity.effects.12: Earn 1 Veneration Point every time you place an apprentice on a green grove tile.
help.salamander.description: Salamander cards are obtained via the "Activate the temple" action. You immediately take the gains indicated on the card.
help.salamander.bonus.2: Gain 2 scroll tokens and 4 Veneration Points
help.salamander.bonus.4: Gain 2 scroll tokens and 2 Veneration Points
help.salamander.bonus.5: Gain 1 scroll token and 2 Veneration Points for each white field tile with at least one of your apprentices.
help.salamander.bonus.6: Gain 1 scroll token and 2 Veneration Points for each purple field tile with at least one of your apprentices.
help.salamander.bonus.7: Gain 1 scroll token and 2 Veneration Points for each divinity card in your possession.
help.salamander.bonus.51: Take a bear card and gain 2 Veneration Points for each green field tile with at least one of your apprentices.
help.salamander.bonus.53: Reactivate one of your apprentices and gain 7 Veneration Points
help.salamander.bonus.54: Reactivate one of your apprentices and gain 2 Veneration Points for each orange field tile with at least one of your apprentices.
help.salamander.bonus.55: Harvest a grove tile and gain 8 Veneration Points
help.salamander.bonus.56: Harvest a grove tile and gain 5 Veneration Points
help.salamander.bonus.57: Take an eagle deity card and gain 6 Veneration Points
help.secondary-divinity-board.title: Secondary divinity board
help.secondary-divinity-board:
When building a tile, if the tile you have just built shares a color with a tile it is in contact with, take the visible Secondary Divinity card of your choice (Eagle or Bear).

Place it in front of you: the effect of this card now applies for the rest of the game.
tuto.druid:
In Salamandra, you play as a <bold>erudite</bold>. Your goal is to send your <bold>apprentices</bold> to gather magical leaves, flowers and fruits and use them to bring the <bold>Temple of Salamandra</bold> back to life.
The scholar with the most <bold>Veneration points</bold> at the end of the game wins and becomes <bold>Great Druid</bold>!
tuto.apprentice: Each player has <bold>10 apprentices</bold>. Here are yours.
tuto.rounds:
Salamandra is played in <bold>4 rounds</bold> (one day, one night, one day, one night).
In the first round, only 3 apprentices are available. The others will become available in subsequent rounds.
tuto.turns:
Players take it in turns to play.
On your turn, you must perform one of <bold>5 possible actions</bold>.
tuto.place: The first possible action is to place one of your <bold>available apprentices</bold> on a tile.
tuto.field:
Here are the 4 basic <bold>Field tiles</bold>.
Each tile has 4 slots available for apprentices.
tuto.place-leaf: Place one of your available apprentices at this location.
tuto.place-vp:
You have placed your apprentice on <bold>1 PV</bold> (point of Veneration). You score this point immediately.
<italic>Your VPs are displayed on the left, under your name, in your player panel.</italic>
tuto.grove: The chosen location is also connected to paths with 2 <bold>crystals</bold>: <crystal/>. You immediately gain these 2 <crystal/>.
tuto.cristal:
You also gain <bold>2 <crystal/> at the start of each round</bold>: so you now have 4 <crystal/>.
The <crystal/> are useful during the other 4 actions. Meanwhile, it's your opponent's turn to play.
tuto.opponent.1: Your opponent placed his apprentice here, earning 1 VP and 1 crystal.
tuto.build: The second possible action is to build one of the <bold>4 available Field tiles</bold>.
tuto.cost:
Tiles cost <bold>crystals and/or resources</bold>.
For example, this tile costs 2 <crystal/> and 1 <leaf/>.
tuto.resource:
To generate a resource (<leaf/>, <flower/> or <fruit/>), work an active <bold>apprentice</bold> located on a <sickle/> Billhook tile.
Activate this apprentice to harvest 1 <leaf/>.
tuto.inactive: This apprentice is now <bold>inactive</bold>. It can be activated again during the next round (night).
tuto.resource.cost:
Resources (<leaf/> <flower/> <fruit/>) are perishable: you can't keep them from one turn to the next.
It is also possible to generate a resource by paying 4 <crystal/>.
tuto.field.place: Now place this Field tile here.
tuto.field.bonus:
You immediately earn the bonus indicated below the cost of the tile. Here, a scroll: <scroll/>.
We'll see what they're for later.
tuto.field.option:
Finally, if possible, choose one of the following 2 options:
• Immediately place an available apprentice on the tile.
• Take the available <bold>Eagle or Bear card</bold>. This option is <bold>available only if the tile has a color in common</bold> with an adjacent tile.
tuto.cards:
Your tile is placed next to another white tile, so you can take one of these 2 cards.
You can click on them to see their effect.
Take the Eagle card.
tuto.opponent.3: Your opponent has placed this tile, and immediately placed his apprentice on it.
tuto.cauldron: This tile has a <cauldron/> symbol. The 3rd type of possible action is to perform the effect of a <cauldron/> tile by activating an apprentice on the tile.
tuto.place.flower: Now it's your turn. Place your apprentice here.
tuto.scroll:
Placing your apprentice earns you another scroll: <scroll/>.
Your scrolls are stored here.
tuto.grimoire:
As soon as you have <bold>4 scrolls</bold>, you can move one of your apprentices to one of the <bold>Spellbook cards</bold>.
These cards earn VP at the end of the game, but your apprentice will no longer be able to work in the fields.
At any time, you can click on the cards to see their effect.
tuto.opponent.4: Your opponent has activated this apprentice and paid 2 <crystal/> to gain one <scroll/> and 3 VP.
tuto.temple: The 4th possible action is to activate the <bold>Temple of the Salamander</bold>.
tuto.salamandra: To take a Salamander card, you need to activate any apprentice, as well as a potion (<potion1/> or <potion2/>) and 1 or 2 <crystal/>.
tuto.potion: You can make <potion2/> by activating this tile, but you need a <flower/> first.
tuto.buy-flower:
You can activate this tile to harvest a <flower/>, but if you do, you'll have no active apprentice left to take a Salamander card!
Instead, buy the <flower/> with 3 <crystal/> (thanks to your eagle card) by clicking on the "+" button, left in your player panel.
tuto.create-potion: Now activate your apprentice to transform <flower/> into <potion2/>.
tuto.salamandra.take: Now acquire this Salamander card by activating your latest apprentice.
tuto.pass: The 5th and last possible action is to pass. Click on "pass" in the header.
tuto.grove.gather: When you pass, you can <bold>harvest Groves</bold>.
tuto.grove.cost:
You can only harvest Groves connected to one of your apprentices by a path.
In addition, each Grove harvested costs 3 <crystal/>.
tuto.grove.bonus:
When you harvest a Grove, you earn the bonus shown in the center.
Harvest the grove of your choice by placing it on top of your board.
tuto.grove.vp: The second Grove harvested gives 4 VP at the end of the game, the 4th Grove gives 3 VP, and the 6th Grove gives 2 VP.
tuto.round.end:
Once all players have passed, the next round begins.
Apprentices stay where they are, and new apprentices become available!
tuto.game.over: The game ends after the end of round 4.
tuto.grimoire.vp: At the end of the game, players earn VPs from <bold>Spellbook cards</bold>.
tuto.majorities:
For each belief, the 2 players with the most symbols (<bear/> <eagle/> or <crown/>) on their <bold>Divinity cards</bold> win VPs.
For example, the player with the most <crown/> wins 12 VPs, the second most 6 VPs.
<italic>Click on your opponent's player panel to see their cards!</italic>
tuto.scroll.vp:
Each unused <scroll/> also yields 1PV.
The player with the most VP wins and is named <bold>grand Druid</bold>!
tuto.end: Now it's your turn, and may the goddess Salamandra accompany you!
